_comment: SpaceMiT K1 (X60), 8 cores. Cluster 0 = cores 0-3 (scalar+RVV+IME), cluster 1 = cores 4-7 (scalar+RVV). Both clusters share ONE cpufreq policy pinned to performance at 1.6 GHz, so there is no per-cluster DVFS skew to model. Profiles are single-core (topo_0) because the K1 uses per-core scheduler combinations: each core is independently schedulable, so a 4-hart timing would credit one core with the whole cluster's throughput.
_capabilities_comment: IME is measured, not assumed: smt.vmadot executes on cores 0-3 and SIGILLs on 4-7 (artifacts/k1_bringup/*/ime_capability_probe.txt). It is therefore a property of cluster-0 cores, never a separate machine -- see xpu-rt/capabilities.py.
_concurrency_comment: machine_combination_mode=singletons: each of the 8 cores is independently schedulable, so 8 dispatches can genuinely run at once. This is why the profiles above are single-core (topo_0).
